_**GENERATED — do not hand-edit.** Renders what already exists: cadenced sessions · decisions owed · monitoring coming due · cron cadences._

## CADENCED SESSIONS

- **Daily sync with the operator** — once per day; not time-boxed (operator directive 2026-09-21: no cap on decisions, do not report session length as a metric) _(source: CLAUDE.md § "The daily sync, and standing authorizations")_

- **/health-review** — on demand -- no declared fixed interval; a weekly compliance-audit rotation runs inside it, not as its own trigger _(source: .claude/skills/health-review/SKILL.md)_

  - Trading + strategy performance, per-decision grading, research pipeline.
- **/ml-review** — on demand -- no declared fixed interval _(source: .claude/skills/ml-review/SKILL.md)_
  - Model lifecycle, promotion/demotion against the candidate→shadow→advisory ladder.

## DECISIONS OWED (3)

_Pipeline items DUE with `next_action: ask_operator`. From `scripts/ops/pipeline.py::due()`, never re-derived._

- **PI-20260921-0005** [queued] The dashboard repo (benbaichmankass/ict-trader-dashboard, read-only clone this session, HEAD eaccaaa) has its OWN orphaned readers of the 2026-09-21 reset, independent of anything in this repo's API responses -- fixing src/web/api/routers/work.py's notes (this PR) does not touch these because they are either hardcoded strings or hardcoded links in the SPA's own source, not renders of the API's `note`/`coverage` fields. NOT fixed here -- out of scope, this repo cannot open a PR against the dashboard. Four items: (1) webapp/src/routes/Work.svelte:745 hardcodes the literal string 'A bug to fix still goes to the review backlogs.' inside the coverage-panel template -- the SAME sentence this PR just corrected in work.py's `note` field, duplicated in the frontend where the backend fix cannot reach it. (2) webapp/src/routes/Runbooks.svelte:16-53 hardcodes FIVE reference links under `${REPO}/blob/main/docs/claude/...`: issues/6927 ('Claude coordination board'), DUE.md, PROBES.json, OPEN-ITEMS.json, operator-owed-register.json -- all four *.json/*.md paths were moved to docs/archive/2026-09-21-operating-reset/registers/ by this repo's reset, so all four links now 404 on GitHub (main no longer has docs/claude/OPEN-ITEMS.json etc.); the coordination-board issue link may also be stale depending on #6927's current state (this session could not resolve docs/claude/board-pointer.json to check -- it is itself archived, see PI-20260921-0002). (3) webapp/src/lib/nav.ts:52 describes the Runbooks page as covering 'the coordination board, and what is due today' -- both retired. (4) webapp/src/routes/Work.svelte:551 comment references SESSIONS.json's decay behavior as a live concern; harmless (a code comment, not operator-facing), noted for completeness only. · rerun: `git -C <dashboard-clone> grep -n -i 'board-pointer\|OPEN-ITEMS.json\|SESSIONS.json\|MERGE-QUEUE.json\|coordination.board\|session-board.json\|MANAGER-LEASE.json\|review.backlog\|OPEN-PRS.json\|DUE.md\|PROBES.json\|operator-owed-register.json' -- webapp/src`
- **PI-20260921-E01** [queued] docs/claude/work/OPEN-PRS.json was archived by the 2026-09-21 operating reset (docs/archive/2026-09-21-operating-reset/work/OPEN-PRS.json) and docs/claude/work/README.md correctly says so ('Do not resurrect them'). But three consumers were NOT disarmed and are still LIVE, unlike due-list.yml/probes.yml/error-feed-digest.yml/pr-queue-watch.yml/constraint-readout.yml/scope-overlap-audit.yml (all of which had their schedules commented out in the same reset): (a) .github/workflows/reconcile-open-prs.yml triggers on `push: branches: [main]` — unconditional, fires on every push, confirmed by dated .github/merge-slots/automation-reconcile-open-prs-*.json artifacts from today (2026-09-21); (b) .github/workflows/stale-automation-sweep.yml still carries an un-commented `cron: '17 */2 * * *'`; (c) both call scripts/ops/reconcile_open_prs.py / scripts/ops/open_pr_record.py / scripts/ops/sweep_stale_automation_prs.py, whose RECORD_PATH is docs/claude/work/OPEN-PRS.json. This is NOT the 'writer fails loudly' case this row's note assumed: open_pr_record.py:read_record() returns (None, True) for a missing file — 'read succeeded, nothing there' — so a run against the archived path is silently indistinguishable from a healthy run that found zero rows ('MOST RUNS WILL MOVE NOTHING, AND THAT IS CORRECT' per the workflow's own comment). Not fixed here: pulling on it needs someone to decide whether the PR-settlement tracking OPEN-PRS.json did is superseded by MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json's `prs` field or genuinely dropped. [!] ID REASSIGNED AT MERGE 2026-09-21 BY THE MANAGER. The E9 lane filed this as PI-20260921-0003 while, concurrently and invisibly to it, a DIFFERENT finding was being filed under that same id on main. Neither session could see the other: each minted the next free number from the store it read at startup. Merging as filed would have SILENTLY DISPLACED one of the two, because load() folds to last-record-wins and --check reports `clean` either way. Nothing about this finding changed; only its id. The tool defect is PI-20260921-M04 and has its own lane. · rerun: `git grep -lI 'OPEN-PRS.json' -- ':!docs/archive/**' ':!.github/pr-landing/**' ':!.github/pr-automerge-requests/**' ':!.github/merge-slots/**'`
- **PI-20260921-M08** [routed] R6 IS DEFERRED, NOT SETTLED: 'should the system trade at all right now' was answered 'keep the roster as-is, decide after D1/R1' by the operator on 2026-09-21, with the measurement in front of them — lifetime real-money expectancy -0.3231R over n=431, against a corpus that is fee-only and optimistic by an unknown amount (+0.57R on the one leg anyone checked). [!] THIS ROW EXISTS BECAUSE A DEFERRAL WITH NO DUE CONDITION IS HOW A DECISION GETS SILENTLY SETTLED. 'Decide after X' is precisely the shape the follow-through pipeline was built for: nothing about the answer makes it ask for attention again, and the corpus re-run is days out. Without this row the question quietly becomes 'yes, keep trading', forever, by default and without anyone choosing it. [!] WHEN IT COMES BACK, the question is NOT re-asked cold — it is re-asked WITH the re-run corpus's verdict, which is the whole point of waiting. [!] THE derisk_only MANDATES ARE NOT BLOCKED by this deferral: they read live measurement, not the corpus, and their worst case removes exposure. A leg going net-negative on the mirror can still be pulled meanwhile. · rerun: `python3 -c "import json;d=json.load(open('docs/claude/work/MANAGER-CHECKLIST.json'));r=[i for i in d['items'] if i['id']=='R1'][0];print('R1 state:',r['state'])"; # THE DEFERRAL EXPIRES when R1 reaches landed_unproven or done`
